candidate.strip: Dedicated same-clock true-dual-port storage: A accepted CPU read/write with two byte enables; B continuously reads physical renderer/reset diagnostic address, exactly one-clock output. Preserve read-before-write collisions. Keep output response at original accepted bus edge; adding an extra q pipeline into mdin would alter CPU semantics.
candidate.work: Use true-dual-port storage. A handles mutually exclusive CPU, paused hiscore, or ordinary HLE. B supplies coin branch second write0x22 while A writes0x29. Preserve old high0x29 with an8-bit shadow initialized0 and updated by every high-byte write to that word under identical priority. Never substitute new0x29 high. Physically unused debug_work read may be optional observation service; simulator behavior must be explicit and retained, not silently removed.
candidate.response: RAM read output and latched response-kind may update at original acceptance edge, with bus iEdb selection after that edge. Alternatively an early registered read requires proof address/output are valid at every unchanged acceptance. Keep AS/strobe predicate261–262, bus_done/DTACK263/160, pause acknowledge52, HLE side effects and counter timing unchanged.
inference_obligations: Read ports isolated into RAM-compatible clocked processes; no reset on memory array
Native byte-enable width and simultaneous two write ports must map supported M10K mode
Verify actual CycloneV same/mixed-port OLD_DATA support and collisions in simulation + current synthesis report; no no_rw_check/dont-care waiver
Do not assert a fitting/resource pass from geometry alone

resource_reasoning.qualification: Numerical correspondence is a hypothesis, not a resource attribution. SoundROM524288bits dominates this sum; strip/work optimization alone may leave the main problem. Source clocked sound read187 selects byte directly from sound_rom; loader93 and physically unused debug123 are other sites. Obtain actual final per-memory inference before assigning cause. MainROM already inferred, leave unchanged.
resource_reasoning.storage_packing_candidate: At512x16 per RAM block, strip8+work4 blocks; physical mode/byte-enable geometry and full fitted M10K/bit gates remain authoritative. No device-total claim.

minimum_check_before_map.storage_contract: One finite old/new service comparison covering high/low/both byte CPU accesses, both HLE coin branches with nonzero old0x29 high, simultaneous renderer collision, both hiscore byte lanes after acknowledged pause, reset retention and zero power-up. Compare old read data and both memory writes at the original edge.
minimum_check_before_map.actual_CPU: Then one bounded paired real-fx68k/native renderer input prefix through known boot writes and actual coin/start HLE transactions, sufficient to exercise port arbitration; compare each accepted transaction tick/AS/strobes/DTACK/data, render read latency/RGB and resulting RAM. Define terminal from actual transaction coverage, not arbitrary full-game length. Existing historical captures are baseline provenance, not current-candidate execution. No replay performed here.
